_meta.description: BMIQ Evidence Library — Layer 1 Source of Truth. Mirrors mmiq_evidence_library.json. Holds the dimension targets, risk-possibility rules, and published effect-size anchors that the BMIQ v2 engine scores against. The auto-research loop proposes deltas to THIS file; the engine reads it. Never override these values with LLM output — changes flow only through the lens-eval gate (see RESEARCH_LOOP.md).

dimensionTargets.note: Treat raw PBF as soft signal; BIA under-reads fat ~3-4% in obese (Sun AJCN 2005). Prefer FMI.
Raised 0.20->0.25 in v2; SMI is the single strongest discriminator of the high-risk phenotype (r=-0.50).
Falling ICW + rising ECW/TBW = poor-quality, muscle-losing weight loss (early-warning).

riskRules.name: Sarcopenic Obesity
riskRules.condition: low SMI (sex-specific) AND high fat-mass index
riskRules.conditionReadable: Low skeletal-muscle index combined with high fat-mass index
riskRules.clinicalMeaning: Low muscle on a high-fat frame. Highest-risk BMIQ phenotype (n=118 in cohort, 82% women, older). Muscle — not fat or BMI — is the strongest risk discriminator.
riskRules.recommendedAction: Protein to 1.2-1.6 g/kg + resistance/arm loading; re-scan SMM in 90 days.

riskRules.name: High Visceral Adiposity
riskRules.conditionReadable: Visceral fat level at or above 15
riskRules.clinicalMeaning: Central adiposity driving cardiometabolic and renal risk independent of BMI.
riskRules.citation: Yu P et al. Front Endocrinol 2022;13:1052736. doi:10.3389/fendo.2022.1052736
riskRules.recommendedAction: Prioritise visceral-fat reduction; screen renal function.

riskRules.name: Fluid Overload / Inflammatory-Obese
riskRules.clinicalMeaning: Relative overhydration / inflammation; co-travels with lower muscle and higher visceral. Frail-obese signal.
riskRules.citation: Ng JK et al. PLoS One 2018;13(8):e0202203. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0202203
riskRules.recommendedAction: Confirm with LookinBody export (OCR-noise caveat); track ICW trend.

riskRules.name: Rapid Lean Loss on Incretin Therapy
riskRules.condition: on GLP-1/GIP AND >2% SMM loss between serial scans
riskRules.conditionReadable: Skeletal-muscle loss >2% across serial scans while on incretin therapy
riskRules.clinicalMeaning: Incretin weight loss carries lean mass with it; cohort lost ~15% of weight as muscle (favourable end of literature, but still sub-optimal quality).
riskRules.effectSize: GLP-1 lean loss ~25% of weight lost (RCT meta)
riskRules.citation: Karakasis P et al. Metabolism 2024;164:156113. doi:10.1016/j.metabol.2024.156113
riskRules.recommendedAction: Resistance training during therapy preserves lean mass (Locatelli, Diabetes Care 2024). Enforce protein floor.

riskRules.name: Muscle-Loss-Predominant (hidden)
riskRules.condition: SMM down >2% AND fat flat/up AND weight ~stable
riskRules.conditionReadable: Losing skeletal muscle while fat is preserved or rising at near-stable weight
riskRules.clinicalMeaning: Adverse recomposition invisible to scale-weight monitoring (~6% of serial-BCA cohort). Only serial BCA catches it.
riskRules.recommendedAction: Flag for clinical review; this rule is a candidate for the loop to strengthen with external evidence.
